source.provenance: Created locally from scratch by the isolated LibreCAD candidate installed-codec executable converting source.dxf; no downloaded fixture.

experiment.method: Scratch-only focused test imports the existing generated DWG, calls onLoadingCompleted, and attempts a same-version DWG export without editing the drawing or adding APPIDs. It prints typed/raw metadata and the admission report.
experiment.result: PASS as a refusal characterization: unchanged re-export returns false. This is not a successful re-export.

observations: The generated source contains DICTIONARY 0x30 referencing custom PLOTSETTINGS 0x56. The typed PlotSettings callback reports handle 0x56, owner 0x30 and page setup LIBDXFRW_PLOTSETTINGS_86.

The raw PLOTSETTINGS callback retains 50 bytes at handle 0x56; its exposed parent handle is 0 and its typed payload validation flag is false. A zero exposed raw parent is not proof of the on-wire owner.
The admission report records same-version-raw selection for handle 0x56. Final reference validation reports DICTIONARY producer 0x30 committed, target 0x56 unresolved and not committed.
The same failure occurs without the DIMSTYLE edit or extra source APPID used in the prior experiment; neither is needed to reproduce it.
next: Bind this exact raw carrier to its common header, parent and dependent handle spans using the ODA common-object layout and independent source/decoder evidence; a zero raw metadata owner cannot establish owner stability.

Make DICTIONARY references use the actually selected and committed carrier kind, with strict duplicate, ambiguity, class, source/target and remap checks. Fixing the receipt kind alone must not admit a raw object whose owner or references are unproven.
Add generated-source success and fresh readback plus malformed, wrong-owner, remap, rollback and corrected-retry controls; independently qualify emitted semantics before broadening claims.
limits: Generated self-roundtrip is not independent producer evidence or native semantic qualification.
The temporary harness, binary, logs and drawing are outside the repository; no DWG/DXF fixture was committed.
No parser or writer changes were made for this finding.

ledgerTrace.method: Scratch-only trace logs each raw-object transaction after commit and repeats the unchanged-source export.
ledgerTrace.result: The PLOTSETTINGS 0x56 raw carrier commits; the final DICTIONARY 0x30 reference receipt still names an Object target and reports target uncommitted. sanitizeDictionaryEntries resolves and records Object, whereas raw objects commit under RawCarrier. This is a concrete identity-kind mismatch, not evidence of a missing frame.

referenceSpecification.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
referenceSpecification.limit: The layout prefix is not independent proof of every standalone PLOTSETTINGS profile or the selected raw frame owner.
